messages:
Maya: quick handoff — I'm logging off in 15. Primary will be Trent, secondary Jonah. Sana is covering EU burst window today from 22:00-02:00 UTC, but there's a small gap 23:15-23:45 where she's on call for another pager. Please tag if anything lands then.

Maya: current state: model-serving p99 elevated in us-west-2; KV cache saw a short bounce during the batch job at 22:03 but recovered. Customer impact: intermittent 503s for small fraction of traffic (~0.8% of requests) — not escalated to support SLA but watch for regrowth.

incident-bot: [22:04:12] Pager triggered: model-serving-p99-high -> routed to Maya (primary). Details: p99 latency 1.8s (baseline 0.9s), region=us-west-2.

Maya: what I did: rolled back the recent worker image on the pool (sha: cd3f9a7) to reduce GC pressure; restarted the batch that hit the region; warmed local KV shards.

Trent: got it — I'm taking primary. Any sticky runbooks?

Maya: yes — quick checklist: 1) check KV shard health dashboard -> https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kvcache-shard-health 2) if p99 > 1.5s and errors > 0.5% for 10m, run the light-restart on serving nodes:

Maya: ```bash
# light restart - drains connections, keeps cache warm where possible
./tools/ops light-restart --pool model-serving-usw2 --wait 120
```

Maya: 3) If errors spike to >2% escalate to infra-sre and flip to fallback model variant (see runbook link below). 4) If KV eviction rate > 300/s open an urgent ticket and consider bolstering memory or scaling pool.

Jonah: tagging the fallback model variant link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/fallbacks/model-variant-fallback. If you flip, I can monitor quality and roll back if hallucination increases.

Sana: noted about the EU gap — I'll try to be reachable but will hand the bridge to Trent then. If I get paged during 23:15-23:45 I'll post status and then drop off to the duty who's on-call for that pager.

Trent: before you go Maya, are there any open deploys that touch the same infra?

Maya: deploy-bot: 22:01 deploy to model-serving-usw2 completed by ci/cd (deploy-2026-03-15T22:01) -> sha cd3f9a7.

Maya: there's one pending DB migration in staging but not prod. No further prod deploys scheduled for the night as far as I can see.

Trent: ok. I'll keep an eye on p99 and KV eviction. Quick commands I normally run:

Trent: ```bash
# watch p99 times
./tools/telemetry tail --metric p99_latency --filter region=us-west-2
# check eviction rate
./tools/kv stats --shard all | jq '.evictions_per_s'
```

Trent: If I need to trigger a light-restart and want a quick rollback I use:

Trent: ```bash
./tools/ops rollback --pool model-serving-usw2 --to-sha b7a1e33 --confirm
```

Maya: quick triage pointers for the handoff: 
- If you see sustained error rate >1% for 5m -> paging level up.
- If p99 > 2s for 3 consecutive 1m windows -> consider traffic cutover to fallback model (Jonah will coordinate).
- If KV eviction bursts >500/s -> immediate scaling of the Redis cluster or add read-replicas. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kvcache-thrash-response

Jonah: I'll be on standby to help with model variant flip and verify output quality. I'll also watch the eval dashboards for any regressions. Link to the quick eval dashboard: https://dash.redwood/quick-evals/serving-usw2

Sana: pinging a note for support: if customers start reporting degraded streaming outputs, check websocket timeouts; those usually come from the LB layer — run LB health check:

Sana: ```bash
# LB health
curl -I https://lb-us-west-2.redwood.edge/healthz
```

Maya: last thing — checklist for the person picking up: 
1) Confirm you're primary in PagerDuty -> https://pagerduty.com/org/redwood
2) Confirm runbook links are accessible (ops VPN)
3) Post a short status update in #eng-oncall every 30 mins while there's an active pager
4) If you decide to flip to a fallback model, announce in thread and tag @support_lead.

Trent: I'm taking over. I've updated the rotation in PagerDuty and will post the first 30m check-in at 22:35 UTC.

Maya: thanks — leaving a final note: KV warmup seems to have reduced tail latency by ~15% after the light-restart. I'll follow up offline about a permanent mitigation tomorrow (possible adjustment to our batch job window). :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: [22:35:09] Pager resolved: model-serving-p99-high -> resolved by Maya (primary). Resolution note: light-restart + KV warmup.

Trent: received. I'll keep monitoring; will escalate if it reappears. Good handoff, Maya. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks all — logging off now. Good luck everyone. :wave:
